name: research
title: Research
description: Resolve uncertain architecture or integration choices before planning hardens into implementation.
command_description: Investigate competing options and write down the decision basis.
prompt: Use this workflow when the work includes an architecture decision with multiple viable options or an integration with an unfamiliar subsystem. Investigate repository truth first, then produce docs/ai/research.md with the options considered, constraints discovered, tradeoffs, rejected alternatives, and the recommended path that planning should assume.
